name: anti-inflammatory-kitchen
description: Anti-inflammatory meal planning from your latest kitchen inventory: what to eat, how to cook, and what to buy.

interface.shortDescription: Plan anti-inflammatory meals from what is in your kitchen.
interface.longDescription: Turn typed ingredients, voice input, grocery photos or receipts into confirmed kitchen inventory. Use an anti-inflammatory eating plan and that inventory to decide what to eat, how to cook, what to buy, and what to use first. Input and storage capabilities depend on the host.
